submittedPrompt: 绘制中文博客网页局部状态对照板，白底浅灰面、蓝色主动作、细线小圆角、字体清晰紧凑。各行独立，细线留白分隔，只画指定局部、不画外部导航/全页头或审查注释。五个独立紧凑恢复片段。1 博客红色提示“暂时无法读取博客，请重试。”，现有按钮“重试”。2 首次文章详情失败卡：标题“文章详情暂时无法读取”，说明“暂时无法读取文章。”，按钮“重新读取文章”。3 发布检查区标题“发布前核对”，现有文字按钮“刷新检查”，红色错误“暂时无法读取发布检查。”；不加另一个重试按钮。4 主页实时预览失败：标题“访客视角”，小字“未保存的修改也能预览”，原有按钮“刷新预览”，红色错误“暂时无法生成主页预览。”，旁边现有“重试预览”；下方保留一小块已有成功预览的正文“隔离示例手记 / 让知识保持可用”，不声称已发布。5 装修版本错误：“博客装修已变化，请重新读取”，按钮“重新核对版本”，下面保留局部“姓名”输入“示例作者”，不丢本地输入。不要把五种恢复按钮合成一个，不加重新登录、保存成功或自动发布。

sourceContracts.title: 博客管理：冲突与保留修改恢复

entry.trigger: Concurrent remote change, failed request or post-save read failure

permissionRules: Owner session required for /api/blog; no anonymous management surface. Publication snapshots and site enabled state remain independently controlled.

actions.label: 重新核对 / 重新核对设置 / 重新核对版本
actions.effect: Read latest corresponding resource and preserve applicable local fields

importantStates: article/version/source changed blocks publish and refreshes detail
failed metadata save retains local form
post-save read failure must be reviewed before next publish
design save/publish/restore error retains draft and version-review entry

responsive.supported: Source-defined responsive layout; not runtime-verified in this read-only inventory
responsive.behavior: <=860px article list/detail and taxonomy become one column, list retains bounded scroll and stats become two columns; <=680px smaller padding/actions, <=720px compact header (blog-admin.css:1082). Runtime unverified.

sourceContracts.designReason: A concrete state with its own content, action hierarchy and business state; include in the GPT Image 2 review queue before implementation.
notes: There is no custom global offline mode; these are concrete request-failure alerts and preserved-memory drafts. Browser reload durability for article/design forms is not established here.

postprocessing: Original built-in PNG copied byte-for-byte; no pixel edits.

caption.title: Component state matrix: owner-private / BlogWorkspace.vue
caption.state: Five independent real recovery regions: dashboard load retry; initial article detail retry; publication review refresh; live homepage preview retry; design config/version recheck. Each source renderer action drawn separately with no invented generic retry.

selfInspection.method: Actual native generated PNG viewed against all input images and exact source template/conditional state contracts.
concerns: Static raster is not proof of executed actions, owner/recipient permissions, focus/keyboard, guard enforcement, canvas topology or responsive fit.
Light raster shading and approximate geometry are illustrative; exact source labels and shared flat CSS tokens remain implementation requirements.
Source-derived selected component/state; actual matching runtime capture is unavailable. Supplied actual screenshot is only parent/host reference where present.

stateMatrix.title: dashboard/preview/review failures expose separate recovery

guardBindings.label: 重新核对 / 重新核对设置 / 重新核对版本

stateMatrix.presentation: 同一真实组件的该结构状态；聚焦受影响字段/列表/预览区域，保持可读。
stateMatrix.reuseRule: Only named representative is visibly drawn; same actual renderer and role, exact source fields/data/guards remain in stateCoverage.
